title: Where Steinau heard Sharkey, Raymond Burke and Johnny Wiggs
summary: Steinau recalls hearing Sharkey at the Famous Door and Parisian Room concerts, Burke only with Wiggs, and Wiggs at a jazz club meeting and the record shop back room.
